Movement Speed Slider
Version 1.0.0

A slider in the game's own menu that sets your movement speed. Journal, System, Settings, Gameplay, beneath Difficulty.

25% to 150%, one percent per press. 100% changes nothing. It scales walking, running and sprinting alike, and only you: NPCs and your horse keep their speed.

It is kept in the mod's INI, never in your save, and stays where you left it across saves, new games and restarts, as the game's own settings do. Remove the mod and any save walks at the normal speed.

DEFAULT MOTION
Beneath the slider: Run or Walk, default Run. On Walk you walk with the real walk animation and speed, on a controller too. The Sprint button still sprints. The slider scales walking too. A horse walks as well, as it does on a keyboard with run off. Kept in the INI, never in your save.

REQUIRES
SKSE and Address Library for SKSE Plugins. Skyrim SE 1.5.97, AE 1.6.1170, or 1.7.99 / 1.7.104.

WORKS WITH
Any journal that keeps the game's System page: the game's own, SkyUI, Quest Journal Overhaul, Norden UI. No plugin, no scripts, no file of the journal is replaced.

LICENCE
GPL-3.0-or-later. Source: https://github.com/ApocryphaRealm/MovementSpeedSlider
